value.rationale: An exact, sharp structural transition at hub degree six determines whether fully accepted relationships can rupture during opinion averaging, and the threshold prescribes the minimum confidence reinforcement that universally prevents rupture and guarantees consensus. The star formula reduces a graph-wide infinite transport test to one explicit inequality, providing a meaningful model-design boundary independent of the confidence-decay parameter.
